task: T177 wrapper-only tricks (median, per-sym temp, per-sym thresh)

A_median.description: Median instead of mean across 5 seeds

B_per_sym_temp.description: Per-sym temperature scaling of combined pred_dmid (tuned on 0-95)

D_combined.description: All three: median (A) + per-sym temp (B) + per-sym thr_factor (C)

insights.A_median: Negative: median ensemble is worse than mean for this dataset (noise reduction hurts signal)
insights.B_temp: Positive: all syms benefit from amplifying predictions ~20%, sym3 slightly less (1.1x). Suggests predictions are systematically under-confident
insights.C_thresh: Best individual: lowering thresholds 30% for syms 0/1/2/4 (more trading) and 10% for sym3 is profitable. Confirms sym3 is more volatile/noisy
insights.D_combined: Sub-additive: median hurts, temp and thresh partly cancel when combined. C alone or B alone are better than D

recommendation: Ship C (per-sym thr_factor) as primary. B is second choice. Skip A and D.
